title: Hatikvah (The Hope)
attribution: Words from Naftali Herz Imber's poem "Tikvatenu" (written 1878, printed 1886; Imber died in 1909), with the refrain in the form it had taken among the early settlers by 1905 (usually credited to Yehuda Leib Matmon-Cohen, died 1939). The melody was fitted to it in 1888 by Samuel Cohen (died 1940) from the Moldavian folk tune "Carul cu boi". All public domain.
